Message:
With each stroke of Fia’s fingers
against my petals,
my consciousness would
begin to stir.

Then, one day, I realized that
my consciousness was now
inside of a flower.
The reason for that lay with me.

I was the one who once turned
an entire city to dust—
the “Witch of Murder.”

Unable to bear the weight of
the sin I had wrought,
I rid myself of all guilt.

A trace of it must have
remained in this flower,
making me into what I am now.

In other words, what I am now is
the part of my heart I’d abandoned
screaming out—
the forgotten fragment
of my own soul.

Fia’s hand suddenly stopped
brushing against the flower.

Her trembling fingers halted
on a lone petal,
now withered brown.

Her shaking voice
made my chest ache.

Fia may come across as cold,
but in truth,
she’s just hard to read,
and an ordinary girl at heart.

But, there was nothing I could do.
Ever since the day
I turned my hometown to dust,
I’ve been unable to do anything
but stand by and watch...
